cells.reason: Paraguay Decree 1335/2019 (active from 2019-02-20; incorporates MERCOSUR GMC Res. 12/11) Annex Part II total-arsenic row 'cephalopod molluscs' sets 1 mg/kg on the product as offered to the consumer, a content basis that coincides with as-consumed for uncanned raw cephalopods; the regulation page confirms arsenic is total arsenic and that limits apply to the edible portion. No non-gated content-basis tAs row scoped to cephalopods, molluscs or seafood is stricter: MERCOSUR cephalopod molluscs, AU-NZ molluscs, Singapore fish-crustaceans-molluscs, Uruguay solid foods in general and Trinidad foods-not-named all sit at 1000, Trinidad marine animal products at 5000, India molluscs at 86000, Thailand's arsenic residual at 2000, and the Guyana 200 ppb row is quarantined. Inorganic-arsenic rows (EU 2025/1891 cephalopods 50; HK and CN aquatic animals other than fish 500) are a different analyte and not tAs candidates; the species bound iAs 50 <= tAs 1000 is satisfied.
